panels.title: Workflow recovery rate
panels.description: Metric workflow_recovery_rate from the measurement dictionary: the latest snapshot version per window. A null value carries its reason.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT window_end AS "time", value, null_reason, snapshot_version
FROM metric_snapshots_latest
WHERE organization_id = '$organization_id'
  AND project_id = '$project_id'
  AND metric_name = 'workflow_recovery_rate'
  AND dictionary_version = '1.1.0'
  AND dimensions = '{}'::jsonb
  AND $__timeFilter(window_end)
ORDER BY window_end
